capabilities: Render and edit .docx, .pptx and .xlsx files in Obsidian
Preserve unedited file content byte-for-byte on save
Track changes, comments, formulas, charts and pivot tables
Embed and link to slides, cells and document headings from notes
Export to PDF, PNG, CSV, .docx and Markdown
disambiguation: Not a Markdown-to-Word converter only; it is a full in-app editor for .docx, .pptx and .xlsx files, though it also exports notes to .docx and Markdown.
extras: Beta desktop-style ribbons are available per file type in settings. Version history is stored inside the plugin, not in the vault. Macro-enabled .docm/.pptm/.xlsm files open with macros kept but never run. If another plugin already handles .docx, .pptx or .xlsx, the README says to disable it.
problem: Obsidian cannot natively open or edit Office documents, so Word, PowerPoint and Excel files must be handled in separate applications outside the vault.
summary: Plugin that opens and edits Word (.docx), PowerPoint (.pptx) and Excel (.xlsx) files inside Obsidian with Office-like rendering, editing and export.
